subtitle: Wax Pour Sitting Journal
promotional_text: Time every vessel in a wax sitting. Log pour jobs, wax lots, and bench pace, then estimate how many pieces fit the day. Fully offline and private.
description: Pour Ledger times each vessel in a wax sitting, logs pour jobs, and reviews bench pace. Offline studio journal with no account.
app_review_notes: Offline wax-pour journal. No sign-in. Add a pour job, start a sitting, log a vessel, then open Review.
